name: Overload Lightfused Herb
tooltip:
Overload Lightfused Herb
5 yd range
5.3 sec cast
Overloading a Lightfused herb will result in an outpouring of the stored holy energy. These motes can be caught before dissipating on the ground, resulting in the collection of usable reagents and a bit of a sunburn.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
